payload.title: fgos gateway start|stop|status: give any agent working in this repo a one-door way to…
payload.description: fgos gateway start|stop|status: give any agent working in this repo a one-door way to launch/stop/check the herdr-fgos gateway (REST API + web dashboard, herdr-plugin/src/gateway.rs) as a detached background process, without hand-rolling nohup/tmux/systemd. Model the process registry (.fgos/gateway.json: pid, port, startedAt, logPath) and PID liveness check on src/runner/session.mjs's existing pattern (isPidAlive, lock-guarded registry read/write) -- new module e.g. src/runner/gateway-control.mjs. 'start' builds the release binary if missing/stale then spawns it detached (child_process.spawn, detached:true, unref, stdout/stderr to a log file) and refuses if already running; 'stop' sends SIGTERM to the recorded pid and clears the registry entry; 'status' reports pid/port/uptime/liveness plus a real curl-equivalent reachability check against /v1/contract. Register a read-only 'herdr-gateway-running' check in fgos doctor's registry (src/setup/checks.mjs) reporting current liveness -- informational only, no new config default needed since it reads the EXISTING gateway.token/port/bind from ~/.fgos/config.json, nothing new to merge into fgos setup. Also add a short mandatory doctrine line to AGENTS.md (near the existing 'Dispatch' section's own always-run-this-first convention) instructing any agent that needs the gateway/web dashboard running to run 'fgos gateway start' rather than a raw cargo run/nohup -- this is the standing instruction the user asked for after confirming MCP can't self-bootstrap the gateway it runs on (chicken-and-egg: mcp.rs's search/execute tools are mounted on the gateway's own router, so they cannot be used to start the gateway itself).

payload.title: fix real gaps found in tsk-31v's fgos gateway start|stop|status code review: (1) no lock around…
payload.description: fix real gaps found in tsk-31v's fgos gateway start|stop|status code review: (1) no lock around start/stop's read-check-write registry sequence -- two concurrent 'fgos gateway start' calls can both pass the not-running check before either writes, AND both share the SAME fixed .fgos/logs/gateway.log path so one invocation's startup-confirmation poll can see the OTHER invocation's process's 'listening on' line, recording the wrong pid. Fix: add a session.mjs-style PID-liveness-based lock (.fgos/gateway.lock, no TTL -- the critical section can run 60-90s during a cold cargo build, TTL would be wrong here) guarding the whole start/stop critical section, PLUS a unique per-invocation log filename (timestamp+pid) so no two starts ever share a log file even without the lock as a second independent fix. (2) gatewayStatus's fetch() to /v1/contract has no timeout -- a gateway that's alive but hung makes 'fgos gateway status' hang forever instead of reporting reachable:false quickly; add AbortSignal.timeout(). (3) minor: execFileSync's cargo build call uses the 1MB default maxBuffer, risking ENOBUFS on a verbose cold build; bump it. (4) minor: stopGateway clears the registry immediately after sending SIGTERM without confirming the process actually died, so a status call right after stop can briefly still report running:true; poll isPidAlive briefly after SIGTERM (SIGKILL as a last resort) before clearing the registry.
payload.verify: chưa xác định — P15 bổ sung
